notes: Arcane Mage: manage Arcane Charges (max 4), burn mana with Arcane Surge + Touch of the Magi window, conserve with Evocation.

Arcane Blast.description: Primary filler. Generates 1 Arcane Charge per cast (max 4). Damage and mana cost scale with charges.

Arcane Missiles.description: Only cast with Clearcasting proc. Generates 1 Arcane Charge. Doesn't cost mana with Clearcasting.

Arcane Barrage.description: Dumps all Arcane Charges for AoE damage. Resets to 0 charges. Use to conserve mana or in AoE.

Arcane Surge.description: Primary DPS cooldown. Requires 4 Arcane Charges. Empowers next spell massively. Use with Touch of the Magi window.

Touch of the Magi.description: Places debuff that accumulates 25% of Arcane damage dealt, then detonates. Use before burn phase.

Radiant Spark.description: Talent CD: creates vulnerability stack on target for subsequent casts.

Evocation.description: Restores 100% mana over 6s. Use when mana drops below ~30% in burn phase.

Presence of Mind.description: Next Arcane Blast is instant. Pairs with Arcane Surge opener.

Time Warp.description: Bloodlust. Use at start of burn phase.

Clearcasting.description: Proc: next Arcane Missiles is free and deals bonus damage. ~10% chance per Arcane Blast.

Arcane Charge.description: Stacks to 4. Increases Arcane Blast/Barrage damage by 60% and mana cost by 100% per stack.

major_cooldowns.name: Arcane Surge

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of the Magi
major_cooldowns.use_condition: Use before Arcane Surge to maximize detonation damage.

major_cooldowns.name: Radiant Spark
major_cooldowns.use_condition: On cooldown, align with burn windows.

arcane_mage.name: Arcane Mage
arcane_mage.description: Standard Arcane build. Manage charges and mana for burn windows.

priority.action: Touch of the Magi on cooldown

error_rules.condition: Arcane Surge not cast within first 8 seconds of encounter
error_rules.message: Arcane Surge zu spät! Primary DPS-CD sofort beim Pull.
error_rules.explanation: Arcane Surge ist der wichtigste Cooldown. Frühzeitiger Einsatz maximiert Nutzungsanzahl.

error_rules.condition: Clearcasting overwritten without casting Arcane Missiles
error_rules.message: Clearcasting verfallen! Sofort Arcane Missiles casten bei Proc.
error_rules.explanation: Clearcasting proc gibt kostenloses Arcane Missiles. Ablaufen lassen = DPS-Verlust.
